mach-1.text: Meet the QV-VF420 vertical form fill seal machine: 20-60 bags per minute, SUS304 contact parts, CE certified. Watch it pack 500g rice bags in our test workshop.

mach-2.text: Another shipment on its way! An 8-station rotary pouch packing line with a 10-head combination weigher is heading to our customer in Saudi Arabia. Thank you for your trust!

adh-1.text: TS-PU300 polyurethane sealant for construction joints: 40-60 min skin time, Shore A 35, available in white, grey and black. REACH compliant.

adh-2.text: Speed up your carton sealing line with TS-HM120 EVA hot melt pellets: 10-15 s open time, clean application, 25 kg bags.

tex-1.text: New season colors for our 3-layer softshell HV-SS3L: 10,000 mm waterproof, 8,000 g breathability, bluesign approved. Which color is your favorite?

tex-2.text: Sustainability matters: our 150D Oxford fabric is made from 100% recycled PET bottles and is GRS certified. Perfect for bags and backpacks.

ene-1.text: Installation done in Bavaria, Germany: two VM-W51 5.12 kWh LiFePO4 batteries with a VM-H6K 6 kW hybrid inverter. 6000 cycles, CE and IEC 62619 certified.

ene-2.text: Weekend camping powered by the VM-P2 portable power station: 2048 Wh LiFePO4, 2200 W AC output. Coffee machine, fridge and lights all day long.
